items.description: Lifter header-prototype argument counts: agreed_counts in tools/reverseapoc/lift.py takes an included header's prototype count and parameter types for callees the header declares, so the 3 compile failures outside Tier 1 (tacp 0x0008C110 E1151 floor/memset, ufo2p 0x00014A30 E1151, ufo2p 0x00073EE0 E1071) compile; measured as converter curve point 14 in .planning/converter-curve/CURVE.md (see CURVE.md:509), TDD

Driver parks a function for the rest of the night once a sweep of one of its sessions has hit (an exact sweep cell): no further sessions are launched on it that night; it is left for flags propose/regate; survey estimate about 570 s per session saved (tools/reverseapoc/driver.py pick/requeue path), TDD

attempt check output shows the session's own compiled object disassembly next to the original's around the first differing instruction, and each sweep cell line shows first_va and size; addresses and mnemonics only, never raw game bytes (tools/reverseapoc/attempt.py _summary, tools/reverseapoc/check.py JSON fields), TDD

Hooks accept brace globs (e.g. {a,b}) in the attempt command forms, and attempt asm / attempt context output is cached per attempt view and reused while its inputs are unchanged (tools/reverseapoc/hooks.py, tools/reverseapoc/attempt.py asm/context only), TDD

The /goal stop condition in session.goal_prompt matches the watcom-decomp skill's stop rules (stop after a sweep hit; avoid the 9-consecutive-Stop-block streak); the SKILL.md change goes only through superpowers:writing-skills with a RED baseline first; tests/test_skill.py stays green (tools/reverseapoc/session.py, .claude/skills/watcom-decomp/SKILL.md), TDD

Project PreToolUse hook (tools/reverseapoc/hooks.py via .claude/settings.json) refuses a Bash/PowerShell command run from a harness worktree, or a script file such a command runs, that spells the main checkout's absolute path; the sanctioned relative REVERSEAPOC_WATCOM_DIR=../../../third_party/watcom stays allowed; brainstorm the exact rule first, TDD

probe/README.md: identify the lines taken from 07.1-RESEARCH preview or planner measurements (around lines 123-126) and either re-measure them with the probe tooling or mark them explicitly as preview figures; docs only, no tooling change
